queue.title: Proposed rail merger would slash 2.1 billion long-distance truck miles from the highway annually, report finds
queue.excerpt: A proposed coast-to-coast rail merger between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern could pull 2.1 million truckloads off American highways annually, creating a major shift for the commercial trucking industry while generating up to $5.8 billion in annual economic, climate, and public-health benefits,…
